title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #5

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a good way to learn the correct sounds of a surah? (1 mark)
   A. Read as fast as possible
   B. Guess from English letters only
   C. Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat
   D. Learn only by writing

2. Which best describes trustworthiness? (1 mark)
   A. Being the tallest
   B. Speaking loudly
   C. Winning every game
   D. Keeping promises and returning what you borrow

3. What does Islam teach about lying, even in jokes? (1 mark)
   A. The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   B. Jokes are always lies
   C. Lying is allowed to friends
   D. Lying is a Sunnah

4. Which hand should a Muslim use for eating? (1 mark)
   A. Either hand equally
   B. Right hand
   C. No hand, use a fork only
   D. Left hand

5. Which hand do we use to hold the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Neither
   B. Both feet
   C. Left hand only
   D. Right hand

6. Which of these is a good time to use the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Only at weddings
   C. Only in winter
   D. Before wudhu and prayer

7. Which skill helps keep a person safe near water? (1 mark)
   A. Archery
   B. Chess
   C. Swimming
   D. Singing

8. Which angel is in charge of rain and provision? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Israfil
   C. Raqib
   D. Jibril

9. Malakul Maut takes souls (1 mark)
   A. Only at night
   B. By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   C. Only from old people
   D. Whenever he likes

10. Which angels do Muslims believe sit beside every person? (1 mark)
   A. Two recording angels
   B. None
   C. Four rain angels
   D. Ten guards

11. How is a light najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   B. Burn it
   C. Wash seven times with soil
   D. Leave it

12. Which is physical purity? (1 mark)
   A. Washing off urine from clothes
   B. Saying sorry
   C. Giving charity
   D. Removing envy from the heart

13. What is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A part inside prayer
   B. A type of dua
   C. Something needed before the prayer starts
   D. A festival

14. How many rak'ahs does Isha have? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Four
   C. Three
   D. Five

15. What did the Prophet say about learning to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Pray in any way
   B. Pray quickly
   C. Pray as you have seen me praying
   D. Never pray

16. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. An-Nasr

17. Which posture is closest to Allah, according to the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ruku
   B. Sujud
   C. Qiyam
   D. Taslim

18. Which is a way of showing kindness to a working donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving it in the sun
   B. Overloading it
   C. Beating it
   D. Giving water and rest

19. Which is a dressing trend to avoid? (1 mark)
   A. Simple kanzu
   B. Clothes worn to show off
   C. Clean uniform
   D. Neat trousers

20. What is a benefit of the Islamic dress code? (1 mark)
   A. Loss of respect
   B. Dignity and protection
   C. Waste
   D. More harm

21. What should you do if a stranger online asks for your address? (1 mark)
   A. Give it
   B. Refuse and tell an adult
   C. Send a photo
   D. Tell friends

22. What is a good media rule? (1 mark)
   A. Ask parents before using devices
   B. Download any app
   C. Use a phone secretly
   D. Share passwords

23. What is "income"? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. Debt
   C. Money earned from work
   D. A gift

24. Which verse says "Call upon Me, I will respond to you"? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 112:1
   B. Qur'an 40:60
   C. Qur'an 1:1
   D. Qur'an 110:3

25. Which of these shows love from parents? (1 mark)
   A. Listening and praising good behaviour
   B. Ignoring
   C. Comparing children
   D. Shouting all day

26. Which is an example of respect? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Greeting parents with a smile
   C. Interrupting
   D. Answering back

27. Which is honest behaviour toward parents? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming others
   B. Lying
   C. Telling the truth and not hiding things
   D. Hiding

28. What should we do when a grandparent repeats stories? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Listen patiently
   C. Leave
   D. Laugh at them

29. What should you do if a relative does not visit you? (1 mark)
   A. Still visit them kindly
   B. Never talk to them
   C. Insult them
   D. Ignore their events

30. Which quality did the early converts show? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Loyalty and courage
   C. Laziness
   D. Cowardice

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity. (3 marks)

32. Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent. (3 marks)

33. Explain what the Prophet taught about cutting and selling firewood. (3 marks)

34. How can a child respond politely to a friend who laughs at their modest dress? (3 marks)

35. Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents. (3 marks)

36. How did Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) show generosity? (3 marks)

37. What must a boy and what must a girl cover in prayer at the least? (3 marks)

38. State the duties of Jibril, Mikail and Israfil. (3 marks)

39. Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir. (3 marks)

40. Give three character traits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and one way to practise each. (3 marks)

41. What should a child do when two cousins quarrel? (3 marks)

42. Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave. (3 marks)

43. Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy. (4 marks)

44. State four duties of children to their parents. (4 marks)

45. Suggest four situations in which a Grade 4 child needs patience, tolerance or perseverance. (4 marks)

46. Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat
   Correct Arabic sounds must be learned by listening to a teacher.

2. D — Keeping promises and returning what you borrow
   A trustworthy person can be relied on.

3. A — The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   The Prophet was always truthful.

4. B — Right hand
   The Prophet taught eating with the right.

5. D — Right hand
   The right hand is used for clean, honourable actions.

6. D — Before wudhu and prayer
   The Prophet encouraged it before prayers.

7. C — Swimming
   Swimming can save lives.

8. A — Mikail
   Scholars explain this duty of Mikail.

9. B — By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   Nothing happens without Allah's decree.

10. A — Two recording angels
   The Qur'an (50:17-18) mentions two.

11. A — Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   Sprinkling is enough.

12. A — Washing off urine from clothes
   Physical purity concerns body, clothes and place.

13. C — Something needed before the prayer starts
   Conditions come before the prayer begins.

14. B — Four
   Isha has four.

15. C — Pray as you have seen me praying
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari.

16. A — Al-Fatiha
   It is a pillar.

17. B — Sujud
   A servant is closest in sujud.

18. D — Giving water and rest
   Working animals need care.

19. B — Clothes worn to show off
   Showing off is disliked.

20. B — Dignity and protection
   Modest dress protects a person.

21. B — Refuse and tell an adult
   Strangers can be unsafe.

22. A — Ask parents before using devices
   Permission keeps children safe.

23. C — Money earned from work
   Income is what we earn.

24. B — Qur'an 40:60
   Surah Ghafir 40:60.

25. A — Listening and praising good behaviour
   Love is shown by care.

26. B — Greeting parents with a smile
   Respect is shown by manners.

27. C — Telling the truth and not hiding things
   Honesty.

28. B — Listen patiently
   Patience with the old.

29. A — Still visit them kindly
   Keep ties even if they do not.

30. B — Loyalty and courage
   They stayed firm.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honest work, even hard work like cutting and selling firewood, is better than asking people who may give or refuse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest work, 1 mark for firewood, 1 mark for better than begging.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, explain that they dress that way because of their faith, and do not insult back.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for explaining, 1 mark for not insulting.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: When guests came, he quickly brought a fattened calf to serve them and welcomed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for guests, 1 mark for the food, 1 mark for welcome.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: A boy must cover from the navel to the knees. A girl must cover the whole body except the face and hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy, 1 mark for the girl, 1 mark for the general rule of modest clothes.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brings revelation, Mikail is in charge of rain and provision, Israfil will blow the Trumpet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trustworthy: return borrowed items. Truthful: tell the truth about mistakes. Kind: share your lunch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each trait with a suitable way.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, encourage them to forgive and make peace, and ask an elder if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for peace, 1 mark for asking elders.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Obey in good, respect, thank and make dua, help at home, care for them when old, be honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being teased, failing a test, a friend refusing to play, being sick, dealing with a rude neighbour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable situation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.
